description: Codex-native project hooks generated from .claude/settings.json with codex.external_agent_config.detect/import. PreToolUse blocking and PostToolUse quality output were both verified in live Codex 0.147.0 sessions on 2026-08-12. Canonical implementations remain in .claude/hooks; PostToolUse adapts measured Codex apply_patch payloads to the canonical file_path input. No matchers are used because native tool-name matching was not independently measured. Tracking: docs/handover/followup-backlog.md section J, slug codex-hooks-json-not-dispatched (resolved).

hooks.command: jq -c 'if (.tool_input.file_path? // "") != "" then . elif .tool_name == "apply_patch" then (.tool_input.command | [scan("(?m)^\\*\\*\\* (?:Add|Update) File: ([^\\r\\n]+)$") | .[0]] | unique[]) as $path | .tool_input.file_path = $path else empty end' | while IFS= read -r hook_input; do printf '%s\n' "$hook_input" | CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" bash "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.claude/hooks/post-edit-check.sh"; done
